_comment: The Debug menu's « Test everything » (debug_tests_menu.field_check_all): on each driver, the checks it runs one after the other and the Tests rows it leaves to a person. Read by _shared/diagnostics/engine/field_check/run_all.lua (macOS, Linux) and windows/diagnostics/ui/field_check/run_all.ahk.

run: each entry names a step of the driver's developer field run declaration (macOS diagnostics/data/field_run.json, Linux and Windows diagnostics/data/field_run_steps.json), whose check and deadline_seconds the run uses, so a check has one bound whichever run starts it; row is the Tests row that starts the same check alone, when there is one. A check is listed only when it needs no person (no typing, no dialog to answer, no administrator prompt) and changes nothing it does not put back.

separate: the Tests rows a person must run, each listed in the report as « run separately »; step names the field run step that covers the same point, when there is one. tools/test/test-field-check-all-plan.cjs fails when a Tests row of a platform is in neither list, when a step is not declared for that platform or is not a field_check step, or when a row is not offered on that platform.

The field point ids of the report come from the driver's field_todo_coverage.json (macOS, Linux): every TODO-tests point one of whose checks names the step. Windows has no coverage file; its report names the step only.
